sources.sentence: He felt swallowed up by work during the busy season.

brief.meaningEn: Feel that work occupies so much time and attention that other parts of life are crowded out.
brief.meaningZh: 覺得工作佔去大量時間及注意，其他生活部分被擠走。
brief.grammar: feel/be swallowed up by work; work swallows someone up is the related active image. This lesson uses the passive person-as-consumed frame.
brief.register: Work-as-consuming-force metaphor, not literal swallowing. It describes the person’s experience; one busy day alone does not establish the scope of their whole life.
brief.boundaryZh: 工作佔據感不表示不重視他人或完全沒有選擇，也不以一日忙推一生都如此。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可承認工作內容有價值，同時描述它佔過多注意；外人不可未問便替當事人定感受。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體生活細節寫工作佔據感，保留時段及人物觀點。

listening.promptZh: 這種佔據感靠甚麼表現？

options.en: Work thoughts kept entering dinner time and competed with attention the speaker wanted to give elsewhere.
options.zh: 工作念頭不斷進入晚餐，跟說話者想給其他事的注意互相爭奪。

options.en: The speaker said the brother’s news had no value and deliberately ended contact.
options.zh: 說話者說弟弟近況沒價值，刻意終止聯絡。

options.en: The account described a permanent arrangement covering every week of the speaker’s life.
options.zh: 敘述描述一項永久安排，涵蓋說話者人生每周。

options.en: All messages had been answered before dinner, and work no longer entered the speaker’s thoughts.
options.zh: 晚餐前所有訊息已回，工作也不再進入說話者思緒。

listening.explanationZh: 工作念頭進入原想聽近況的晚餐，是該周感受；不是不珍惜弟弟或已證永久如此。
listening.en: During the launch week, I felt swallowed up by work: even at dinner I kept returning to the unanswered messages, although I wanted to hear my brother’s news and knew the project was only one part of my life.
listening.zh: 推出項目那一周，我覺得被工作佔據；吃飯時也不斷想到未回訊息，雖想聽弟弟近況，也知道項目只是生活一部分。

reply.promptEn: Why did the speaker feel work was crowding out other attention?
reply.promptZh: 說話者為甚麼覺得工作擠走其他注意？

options.en: Unanswered messages kept coming to mind during dinner.
options.zh: 晚餐時，不斷想到未回訊息。

options.en: The speaker felt swallowed up by work because it followed them into time they wanted to share with their brother.
options.zh: 工作跟着進入原想跟弟弟相處的時間，所以說話者覺得被工作佔據。

options.en: They wanted to listen to family news but kept returning mentally to the launch.
options.zh: 他們想聽家人近況，思緒卻不斷回到推出項目。

options.en: The account shows a conflict between the attention they intended to give and what occupied their thoughts.
options.zh: 敘述顯示想給的注意與實際佔據思緒的事有衝突。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以晚餐注意力衝突解釋感受，未否定關係本身。

scene.promptZh: 角色說這周雖工作繁忙，仍能在下班後放下訊息，享受晚餐及散步；未說感到其他生活被吞沒。哪句最超出資料？

options.en: She felt swallowed up by work, unable to give attention to anything outside it that week.
options.zh: 她覺得被工作吞沒，那周無法留意任何工作以外的事。

options.en: She described a busy week with room for activities she enjoyed after work.
options.zh: 她描述一周忙碌，但下班後仍有空間享受活動。

options.en: The number of tasks alone does not establish that she felt consumed by work.
options.zh: 單是任務數量，未能確立她覺得被工作佔據。

scene.explanationZh: 忙碌未必等於她感到被吞沒，需按本人所述下班經驗。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 felt swallowed up by work 推出？

options.en: Work seemed to consume a large share of the person’s time or attention.
options.zh: 工作似佔去當事人大部分時間或注意。

options.en: The person did not value any relationship or interest outside work.
options.zh: 當事人不重視任何工作以外的關係或興趣。

options.en: The account can identify the period and experiences behind the feeling.
options.zh: 敘述可指出感受涉及的時段及經驗。

contrast.explanationZh: 被佔據的感受可正因仍珍惜其他事，不是證明那些事沒有價值。

dialogue.promptZh: 弟弟說：「你晚飯總想着工作，我是不是該等你完全不忙才跟你說近況？」你很想聽，只是那周難抽離工作。哪句最好？

options.en: I have felt swallowed up by work this week, but I do want to hear your news; could we put the screens away and talk after dinner?
options.zh: 這周我覺被工作佔據，但確實想聽你近況；飯後可放下螢幕談談嗎？

options.en: Wait until the entire project is over before mentioning your news; that is the only time worth choosing.
options.zh: 等整個項目完才提你的近況，那才是值得選的時間。

options.en: Tell me while I answer the work messages, and I will assume I can follow both conversations well.
options.zh: 我回工作訊息時你說吧，我先假定兩邊都能好好跟上。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認分心，也直接表達想聽並提可用安排；不能把所有交流拖到項目完，也不在已有分心時假定同時做會聽清。

speaking.en: I felt swallowed up by work during that period, even though I still cared about the people and activities I was missing.
speaking.zh: 那段時間我覺得被工作佔據，卻仍在乎因此錯過的人與活動。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分被佔據感與仍重視的事。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：展覽前一周，你同時負責入口接待及最後字幕核對，感到工作佔滿生活。你想向同伴提出明天由他接待一小時，讓你專心完成核對，之後自己接回；同伴未答應。用一至兩句英文說明情況及請求，不當他已同意。

examples.en: I have felt swallowed up by work while trying to manage both the entrance and the final captions. Could you cover the entrance for an hour tomorrow so I can finish checking the text, then take over from you?
examples.zh: 我同時處理入口及最後字幕，覺得被工作佔滿；明天可替我接待一小時，讓我核完文字後再接回嗎？

examples.en: I am feeling swallowed up by work this week and need to discuss how we divide the remaining tasks. Would you be willing to welcome visitors for the first hour tomorrow while I check the captions, before I return to the desk?
examples.zh: 這周我覺被工作佔據，需談餘下任務怎分；你願明天首小時迎接訪客，讓我核字幕後回接待桌嗎？

glossary.en: cover the entrance for an hour
glossary.zh: 替我在入口當值一小時

writing.selfCheckZh: 以具體雙重任務說工作壓力，提出有範圍的接待代班及自己接回的安排，先問同伴意願，不把請求當已定分工。

takeaways.en: He felt swallowed up by work during the festival, then noticed how many personal messages he had left for another day.
takeaways.zh: 節慶期間他覺得被工作佔據，之後才留意多少私人訊息被擱到另一天。

takeaways.en: The diary described her as swallowed up by work for that month, while still recording the friendships she wanted to return to.
takeaways.zh: 日記寫她那月被工作佔據，也記下她想重新投入的友誼。

brief.meaningEn: Reserve time, money, space or another resource for a particular purpose.
brief.meaningZh: 把時間、金錢、空間或其他資源預留作某個用途。
brief.grammar: set/sets/setting aside + resource for + purpose; past set. A pronoun goes between the verb and particle: set it aside. Setting aside a disagreement temporarily is a different contextual use from reserving a resource.
brief.register: Common phrasal verb. Reserved resources have a designated purpose; they are not necessarily already spent or used.
brief.boundaryZh: 預留不等於已花掉、已完成用途或完全不能再協商；需說明留了甚麼及為何。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不可把未買的物料當已到，也不把專項預留自動算成可任意使用的餘額。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清預留、採購與實際使用，說明共同安排的用途。

options.en: Money had been reserved for replacement labels, which had not yet been ordered.
options.zh: 已預留替換標籤款項，但還未訂購。

options.en: The replacement labels had already arrived and been fitted to the display.
options.zh: 替換標籤已到貨，並裝到展示上。

options.en: The reserved amount was free to spend on anything because no order had been placed.
options.zh: 尚未下單，所以預留款可自由花在任何事上。

options.en: The visitor guide had lost its promised funding before the reserve was made.
options.zh: 預留款建立前，訪客指南已失去答應的經費。

listening.explanationZh: 預留是指定用途，未變成下單或到貨，也未說挪了指南款。
listening.en: We set aside part of the display fund for replacement labels, but had not ordered any yet; the amount was reserved so that a later correction would not depend on taking money promised to the visitor guide.
listening.zh: 我們從展示經費預留一部分作替換標籤，但尚未下單；預留是為了日後更正時，不需挪用已答應訪客指南的款項。

reply.promptEn: Why did you reserve money before knowing which labels might need replacing?
reply.promptZh: 還未知道哪些標籤需替換，你們為甚麼先預留款？

options.en: A later correction would need resources without taking the guide’s promised funds.
options.zh: 日後更正需資源，不應挪用指南已答應的款項。

options.en: We set it aside so a needed correction would have an agreed source of support.
options.zh: 我們預留它，讓必要更正有議定的資源來源。

options.en: The reserve gave a possible future label change a place in the plan.
options.zh: 預留讓可能的日後標籤改動，在計劃內有安排。

options.en: We wanted to separate the two purposes before spending rather than improvise a transfer later.
options.zh: 我們想花費前先分兩項用途，不是之後才臨時調款。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均解釋預先指定用途，不聲稱更正已發生或標籤已買。

scene.promptZh: 會議決定先擱置對海報顏色的爭議，轉談交通，沒有預留任何物料或時間段。哪句最能分清 set aside？

options.en: Here they set aside a disagreement temporarily; this is not the resource-reserving use.
options.zh: 這裏是暫時擱置爭議，不是預留資源的用法。

options.en: They have reserved a specific sum of money to buy new paint.
options.zh: 他們已預留一筆指定款項買新顏料。

options.en: The disagreement has been permanently solved and the new colour has been approved.
options.zh: 爭議已永久解決，新顏色已獲批准。

scene.explanationZh: 擱置討論跟預留資源不同，也不表示爭議已解或顏色已定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能由 set aside money for repairs 推出？

options.en: Some money is designated for the repair purpose.
options.zh: 一部分款項指定作修理用途。

options.en: The repairs have necessarily been completed and paid for.
options.zh: 修理必定已完成並付款。

options.en: The context may explain who agrees how the reserve is used.
options.zh: 情境可解釋由誰議定預留款怎用。

contrast.explanationZh: 預留與實際修理、付款是不同階段。

dialogue.promptZh: 伙伴說既然還未買標籤，就可把預留款全加到裝飾；原定用途仍有需要。哪句最好？

options.en: We set that money aside for corrections; let us discuss any change of purpose before treating it as spare decoration money.
options.zh: 那筆款已預留作更正；把它當裝飾餘款前，先談是否改用途吧。

options.en: No order has been placed, so the reserve no longer has any agreed purpose.
options.zh: 還未下單，所以預留款已沒有任何議定用途。

options.en: Spend the full reserve on replacement labels now, before checking which labels, if any, need changing.
options.zh: 現在先把全筆預留款花在替換標籤，之後才查哪些標籤需要更正。

dialogue.explanationZh: 未花掉仍可有指定用途，改用途需談；也應先查哪些標籤需要更正，不急花掉全筆預留款。

speaking.en: We set aside time for checking the final version, but reserving that time did not mean the checking had already happened.
speaking.zh: 我們預留核最後版本的時間，但預留不表示查核已發生。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分預留與實際完成。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們設計社區展板，伙伴想把每塊板都填滿。你想預留一塊給訪客寫問題，旁邊放筆及說明哪些問題之後有人跟進，不把空白當漏做。用一至兩句英文向伙伴提出具體設計。

examples.en: Could we set aside one blank panel for visitors’ questions, with pens and a note explaining how we will follow them up? The space would have a purpose rather than be an unfinished part of the display.
examples.zh: 可否預留一塊空板給訪客問題，放筆及說明我們之後怎跟進？這空間會有用途，不是展示未完成的部分。

examples.en: I would like to set aside a panel where visitors can add what they want to know. Let us explain which questions we can respond to later, so the blank space invites participation instead of looking accidental.
examples.zh: 我想預留一塊板，讓訪客加想知道的事；說清哪些問題可稍後回應，讓空白邀請參與，而非像偶然漏掉。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指定空板用途及跟進方式，把預留空間與疏漏分清；不保證每項未知問題即時有答案。

takeaways.en: They set aside a quiet hour for reviewing the recordings before choosing what to publish.
takeaways.zh: 他們預留安靜一小時核錄音，再選公開甚麼。

takeaways.en: The shared room was small, but the group set aside one table for materials that still needed checking.
takeaways.zh: 共用房間雖小，小組仍預留一桌放待核物料。

lessons.titleZh: 逆着不利條件艱難前進

target.pattern: \bswim(?:s|ming)? against the current\b|\bswam against the current\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Saving on a tiny income felt like swimming against the current.

brief.meaningEn: Try to make progress while facing strong opposing conditions or prevailing practice.
brief.meaningZh: 在強烈不利條件或與現行做法相反的情況下，嘗試前進。
brief.grammar: feel like/be swimming against the current; swam. Identify what opposes the goal, rather than use the phrase merely for any difficult activity.
brief.register: Conventional resistance metaphor based on moving against flowing water. Resistance need not be deliberate personal hostility, and success or failure is not predetermined.
brief.boundaryZh: 逆流感不等於別人都故意阻撓，也不表示必須單靠意志或必定失敗；要看實際制度、安排或方向衝突。
brief.misconceptionZh: 很難不一定代表有相反力量，支援及結構調整可與個人努力同時考慮。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把目標與阻力連起，提出需改的安排而不只怪個人不夠努力。

listening.promptZh: 逆向阻力及提出的改動是甚麼？

options.en: The purchasing arrangement worked against the reduction goal, so the volunteers asked to review it.
options.zh: 採購安排與減量目標相反，所以義工要求重看。

options.en: The list already supported reusable cups, and the only issue was volunteers refusing to read it.
options.zh: 清單已支持重用杯，唯一問題是義工不肯讀。

options.en: The purchasing list had been revised to reduce single-use packs before the volunteers raised their concern.
options.zh: 義工提出關注前，採購清單已修訂，以減少即棄包裝。

options.en: The volunteers had cancelled the reduction aim and chosen to order more single-use packs.
options.zh: 義工已取消減量目標，選擇訂更多即棄包裝。

listening.explanationZh: 清單仍指定即棄，與減量目標相反；要求重看是改前段安排，未說已改或放棄。
listening.en: Trying to reduce disposable cups felt like swimming against the current when the festival’s own purchasing list kept specifying single-use packs; the volunteers asked to review the list rather than simply collect more cups afterwards.
listening.zh: 節慶本身的採購清單仍指定即棄包裝，讓義工減少即棄杯的努力像逆流前進；他們要求重看清單，不只是事後多收杯。

reply.promptEn: Why did the volunteers ask to review the purchasing list?
reply.promptZh: 義工為甚麼要求重看採購清單？

options.en: The list kept bringing in the disposable cups they were trying to reduce.
options.zh: 清單仍不斷帶入他們想減少的即棄杯。

options.en: They felt they were swimming against the current because the purchasing arrangement opposed their goal.
options.zh: 採購安排與目標相反，讓他們覺得在逆流前進。

options.en: Collecting afterwards did not change the instruction that produced more single-use packs.
options.zh: 事後收集，沒有改變帶來更多即棄包裝的指示。

options.en: They wanted the supplies to be considered alongside the volunteers’ reduction effort.
options.zh: 他們想把供應安排跟義工減量努力一併考慮。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均連到具體相反安排，不把問題只當義工做得不夠。

scene.promptZh: 學員覺得新舞步很難，老師有示範、同伴願慢練，課程也配合她的目標；沒有相反要求或阻撓資料。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The task is difficult, but the account does not by itself establish that she is swimming against the current.
options.zh: 任務困難，但單憑這敘述，未能確立她正逆着不利條件前進。

options.en: The course requires her to stop practising the new movement in order to follow the tutor’s different goal.
options.zh: 課程要求她停止練新動作，改跟導師另一個目標。

options.en: The supporting classmates have already asked her to abandon the skill she wants to learn.
options.zh: 支持她的同伴，已叫她放棄想學的能力。

scene.explanationZh: 她覺動作難，但老師及同伴正配合她的目標，未有課程要求轉向或同伴叫她放棄的資料；難度本身未必等於逆着相反條件前進。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能只憑 swimming against the current 推出？

options.en: Someone is trying to progress despite conditions working in another direction.
options.zh: 有人在條件朝另一方向作用時，仍嘗試前進。

options.en: Every person involved is intentionally trying to make that person fail.
options.zh: 每位相關人士都刻意想讓當事人失敗。

options.en: The account should identify the opposing conditions.
options.zh: 敘述應指出相反作用的條件。

contrast.explanationZh: 阻力可來自安排或習慣，不必是人人惡意。

dialogue.promptZh: 伙伴說義工只需更用力收杯，不該提採購；清單仍指定即棄包裝。哪句最好？

options.en: They are swimming against the current while purchasing keeps creating the same waste; review that arrangement as well as the collection work.
options.zh: 採購持續帶來同類廢物，他們便像逆流前進；應連採購安排與收集工作一起檢視。

options.en: Keep the list unchanged and measure only how quickly volunteers can remove each new batch.
options.zh: 清單照舊，只量義工清走每批新杯有多快。

options.en: Stop collecting the existing cups before anyone has agreed on a replacement arrangement.
options.zh: 任何人議好替代安排前，先停止收集現有杯。

dialogue.explanationZh: 前段安排與現有工作同看，不只加最後工作，也不在替代未定前丟下已有需要。

speaking.en: I feel I am swimming against the current when the process rewards the opposite of the careful work we say we want.
speaking.zh: 流程獎勵的做法與我們說想要的仔細工作相反時，我覺得自己在逆流前進。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出目標與實際阻力。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫訪問摘要，需要如實保留尚未知道的事，但小組表格每欄只准填「是」或「否」，令你被迫把未核資料塞成確定答案。你想請加「待確認」及查問人欄，而不指所有伙伴有惡意。用一至兩句英文提出具體修改。

examples.en: I feel I am swimming against the current when we ask for careful summaries but allow only yes or no for unconfirmed details. Could we add a pending option and name who will check each gap?
examples.zh: 我們要求仔細摘要，卻只讓未核資料填是或否，讓我覺得逆流前進；可否加待確認選項，並指明誰會查每項缺口？

examples.en: Writing honestly feels like swimming against the current in this form, because it has no place for uncertainty. Let us add a space for what is still unknown and who can follow it up, rather than guess at a yes or no.
examples.zh: 這表格無處容納不確定，讓誠實寫作像逆流前進；加入仍未知甚麼及誰可跟進的欄位，不用猜是或否吧。

glossary.zh: 沒有容納不確定的位置

writing.selfCheckZh: 把阻力定位在表格選項與資料精確目標的衝突，提出欄位修改及跟進責任，不用猜答案，也不把制度缺口直接寫成人的惡意。

takeaways.en: Keeping the conversation open felt like swimming against the current when each interruption pushed the group towards a quick verdict.
takeaways.zh: 每次打斷都把小組推向草率定論時，維持開放討論感覺像逆流前進。

takeaways.en: She was swimming against the current of the usual programme, asking for a quiet observation period before the next public presentation.
takeaways.zh: 她逆着慣常計劃的方向，要求下次公開報告前先有安靜觀察時段。

lessons.titleZh: 逐步耗用可用預算或時間精力

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Unexpected repairs eat into my budget.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Long commutes eat into their time and energy.
sources.expression: eat into their time and energy

brief.meaningEn: Use or reduce part of a finite resource, leaving less available for other purposes.
brief.meaningZh: 耗用或減少一部分有限資源，令其他用途可用的餘量減少。
brief.grammar: costs eat into a budget; demands eat into time and energy; ate/eaten/eating. This is the same resource-consumption phrasal verb with different objects, not a reduction in the original budget limit itself.
brief.register: Conventional resource-consumption metaphor. A cost may be necessary and still leave less available; whether it is worthwhile needs separate evidence.
brief.boundaryZh: 資源被耗用不等於原定預算上限被削，也不必已超支或耗盡；需分原額、支出及剩餘。
brief.misconceptionZh: 時間或精力也可作受詞；不能只因有消耗就判事情沒價值。
brief.outcomeZh: 能清楚說哪項資源被耗用、餘量怎受影響，保留價值判斷與實際安排。

listening.promptZh: 預算發生甚麼，沒有發生甚麼？

options.en: Printing used part of the existing funds, reducing what remained without changing the agreed total.
options.zh: 印刷用了原有款項一部分，餘款減少，議定總額未變。

options.en: The organiser reduced the original budget limit before any corrected pages were printed.
options.zh: 印更正頁前，主辦者削低原預算上限。

options.en: The corrected pages cost nothing, so the money available for mounts was unchanged.
options.zh: 更正頁不用錢，所以裝裱可用款不變。

options.en: The group had already replaced every mount before it compared which ones could be reused.
options.zh: 小組比較哪些可重用前，已替換所有裝裱材料。

listening.explanationZh: 是支出耗去餘額，不是預算上限被削；比較重用是下一步，未說全換好。
listening.en: The extra printing ate into our budget for the display: the agreed total stayed the same, but after paying for corrected pages we had less left for mounts, so the group compared which ones could be reused.
listening.zh: 額外印刷耗去展示預算一部分；議定總額不變，但付更正頁後，裝裱可用餘款減少，所以小組比較哪些可重用。

reply.promptEn: Why is the group checking which mounts can be reused?
reply.promptZh: 小組為甚麼查哪些裝裱材料可重用？

options.en: Corrected printing has left less money available for mounts.
options.zh: 印更正頁後，裝裱可用款減少。

options.en: The extra pages ate into our budget, even though the original total was unchanged.
options.zh: 原總額雖不變，額外頁仍耗去了預算一部分。

options.en: The remaining funds need to cover the display after the correction costs.
options.zh: 付更正費後，餘款仍需應付展示。

options.en: Reusing suitable mounts is one option to compare with the amount still available.
options.zh: 重用合適裝裱材料，是可按現有餘款比較的一項選擇。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以更正支出及餘款解釋比較，不把耗用改成上限縮減。

scene.promptZh: 原預留一小時練琴，中途幾次代人核訊息用了二十分鐘，仍有四十分鐘；沒有說核訊息全無價值。哪句準確？

options.en: The checks ate into her available time for practice without using it all up.
options.zh: 查核耗去了她可用練習時間的一部分，沒有耗盡。

options.en: The original hour was cancelled before any checking began.
options.zh: 查核開始前，原本一小時已取消。

options.en: The forty minutes are extra practice added after the original hour, rather than the portion still available within it.
options.zh: 四十分鐘是在原本一小時以外加的練習，不是那一小時內仍可用的部分。

scene.explanationZh: 二十分鐘已佔去原定一小時的一部分，餘下四十分鐘仍在原時段內，不是整段取消或額外加時。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能單憑 eat into a budget 推出？

options.en: A cost uses some money that would otherwise remain available.
options.zh: 一項費用用了部分本來仍可用的款。

options.en: The organiser has necessarily reduced the originally agreed spending limit.
options.zh: 主辦者必定削低了原先議定的支出上限。

options.en: The context should distinguish the original amount from what is left.
options.zh: 情境應分清原額與餘額。

contrast.explanationZh: 耗用資源與削上限、全部耗盡不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 伙伴想把印刷支出寫成「主辦者削了預算」，原總額其實未變。哪句最好？

options.en: The printing ate into our budget; say it reduced the money remaining, rather than claim the organiser cut the agreed total.
options.zh: 印刷耗去預算一部分；應說餘款減少，不聲稱主辦者削了議定總額。

options.en: I will ask the organiser to restore the agreed budget, since the lower balance suggests the original allocation was reduced.
options.zh: 我會請主辦者恢復議定預算，因較低餘額看來表示原分配減了。

options.en: Because the total stayed the same, we can promise the same amount for mounts without checking the remaining funds.
options.zh: 總額沒變，所以不用查餘款，也可答應裝裱仍有同額。

dialogue.explanationZh: 原分配未變，印刷是從中支出的款項；不應把餘款較少讀成主辦者削額，也不能忽略已付費用再承諾同額可用。

speaking.en: The extra requests are eating into our rehearsal time, so we need to agree what can wait until after the practice.
speaking.zh: 額外請求正耗用我們的排練時間，所以需議哪些可等練習後才做。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分資源總額、已耗用與仍可用部分。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友邀你每周到較遠的地方合寫，但來回車程會佔去你原定陪家人的晚上。你仍想合作，想先問能否每月面談一次，其餘用共同文稿；不是批評朋友地點或承諾所有周末。用一至兩句英文提出你的需要。

examples.en: The weekly journey would eat into my available time with my family, though I do want to write with you. Could we meet in person once a month and use a shared draft between visits?
examples.zh: 每周車程會佔去可陪家人的部分時間，但我確想跟你合寫；可每月面談一次，其他時間用共同初稿嗎？

examples.en: I would like to keep working together, but regular travel would eat into my time at home. Would you be open to a monthly meeting, with comments on our shared document during the other weeks?
examples.zh: 我想繼續合作，但定期來回會佔去在家的部分時間；你願每月見面，其餘幾周在共同文件留言嗎？

glossary.en: meet in person once a month

writing.selfCheckZh: 交代車程佔去部分家庭時間，同時保留合寫意願；提出有範圍的面談及共同文稿安排，問對方是否願意而不先當答應。

takeaways.en: The repeated copying ate into her time and energy, leaving less attention for the interview itself.
takeaways.zh: 重複抄寫耗去她部分時間精力，讓訪問本身可得的注意減少。

takeaways.en: Unexpected delivery charges have eaten into their budget, so they are checking the funds left before promising another order.
takeaways.zh: 意外運費耗去他們部分預算，所以答應另一訂單前，他們先查餘款。
